column1: # AQL Language Specification: the aql:report module
# Format: input<TAB>expected<TAB>description
# Loadable module of pretty-printers for kernel value types. Import binds
# the `Report` namespace; each word returns a String the caller can
# `print` or compose: `"aql:report" import end  some-value Report.value`.
# No word performs I/O itself. The record / table / list renderers produce
# multi-line aligned blocks for populated inputs (verified in the Go
# tests, since embedded newlines aren't TSV-expressible); the rows below
# pin the single-line value rendering and the empty-input fallbacks.
# §1  value — generic single-value rendering (FormatForPrint)
aql:report import end 42 Report.value
column3: a scalar renders as its print form

column1: aql:report import end {name:"alice"} Report.value
column3: a map renders inline as its print form

column1: # §2  record — vertical key:value block (single-key stays one line)
aql:report import end {age:30} Report.record
column3: one field renders as a single aligned line

column1: aql:report import end {} Report.record
# §3  table — list-of-maps grid (empty fallback; populated form is multi-line)
aql:report import end [] Report.table
# §4  list — indexed one-per-line (single element stays one line)
aql:report import end [42] Report.list
column3: a one-element list renders as a single indexed line

column1: aql:report import end [] Report.list
